import collections,json,pathlib,re,subprocess
turn="quadratic_sum_source_audit_20260914_141"
dest=pathlib.Path("research/results")/turn
html=pathlib.Path("notebook.html").read_text()
old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:notebook.html"],text=True)
marker="<!-- Append new dated mathematical entries here, preserving earlier entries. -->"
start='<article class="research-entry"'
entry_id="entry-2026-09-14-bounded-probe-sum-source"
entry_start=start+' id="'+entry_id+'">'
assert old[old.index(start):old.index(marker)]==html[html.index(start):html.index(entry_start)]
entry=html[html.index(entry_start):html.index(marker)]
current=html[:html.index(start)]
ids=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"',html))
links=re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"',entry+current)
assert all(ids[a]==1 for a in links+[entry_id])
assert html.count("<!-- TIMING "+turn+" -->")==1
counts=collections.Counter();source_images=0;matrix=None;parameters=[];summary=None
with (dest/"bounded-probe-source-checks.jsonl").open() as f:
    for line in f:
        r=json.loads(line);counts[r["record"]]+=1
        if "passed" in r:
            assert r["passed"] is True
        if r["record"]=="NS_certificate" and "source_axiom" in r:
            source_images+=1
        if r["record"]=="functional_quotient_matrix":
            matrix={"normal_monomials":r["normal_image_dimension"],"evaluation_rank":r["functional_rank"],
                    "rows":len(r["matrix"]),"columns":len(r["normal_monomial_masks"])}
        if r["record"]=="bounded_probe_parameters":
            parameters.append({"ell":r["ell"],"all_sufficient_conditions":
                r["range_space_image_conditions"] and r["old_degree_condition"]})
        if r["record"]=="summary":
            summary=r
assert counts["NS_certificate"]==522 and source_images==22
assert counts["basis_reduction"]==495 and counts["conditional_sum_source_model"]==12
assert counts["sum_span_control"]==7 and counts["probe_restriction"]==4
assert matrix=={"normal_monomials":120,"evaluation_rank":100,"rows":100,"columns":120}
assert parameters==[{"ell":128,"all_sufficient_conditions":False},
                   {"ell":256,"all_sufficient_conditions":True},
                   {"ell":512,"all_sufficient_conditions":True}]
assert summary["NS_certificates"]==522
result={"session":turn,"record_counts":dict(counts),"weighted_source_images":source_images,
        "reduction_and_evaluation":matrix,"finite_parameters":parameters,
        "previous_research_record_unchanged":True,"current_and_new_internal_links_checked":len(links),
        "unique_timing_placeholder":True,"passed":True}
with (dest/"check-metadata.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
